title: Armaments
description: Optional fitting choice. Deck weapons used for defence against the hazards of the Wildsea.

options.name: Trebuchet
options.description: Lobs stones, chunks of wood, or salvage clusters.

options.name: Harpoon Turret
options.description: Fires barbed spears for piercing the hulls of ships and the hides of larger creatures.

options.name: Shrapnel Cannon
options.description: Fires clouds of tearing metal, usually just armfuls of scrap offcuts tossed into the barrel.

options.name: Viper's Tooth
options.description: An unstable weapon that fires corrosive liquid.

options.name: Grand Blastbow
options.description: A crossbow-like emplacement that fires explosive bolts.

options.name: Storm-Rail
options.description: Two huge brass rods wrapped with poorly shielded cables, attached to a voltaic generator.

options.name: Winch-Claws
options.description: A bank of short-range grappling claws on the sides of the ship, used to draw enemy vessels close for boarding.
options.special: A tool to aid close-range encounters rather than a weapon in its own right.

options.name: Broadside Cannons
options.description: A blast from the half-forgotten past, these banks of cannons can only fire at targets to either side.
options.special: Deals massive LR Blunt or Blast damage.

options.name: Ramming Prow
options.description: Allows the ship to ram creatures and other ships without danger to its own hull.

options.name: Spearing Prow
options.description: A set of reinforced spikes jutting from the front of the ship.

options.name: Bladed Prow
options.description: A wedge-like cutting edge for slicing into enemy ships.

options.name: Ripsaw Prow
options.description: A serrated leading edge for cutting through enemy ships.

options.name: Limited Armoury Rack
options.description: A rack stocked with simple weapons for hand-to-hand fighting on the ship.
options.special: Crew can take a temporary LR or CQ weapon with a single damage type (Blunt, Keen, or Spike). It comes with a two-track and cannot be repaired.

options.name: Wrecker's Armoury Rack
options.description: A rack stocked with less straightforward weapons for hand-to-hand fighting.
options.special: Crew can take a temporary LR or CQ weapon with a single damage type (Hewing, Serrated, or Blast). It comes with a two-track and cannot be repaired.
